description: Fix merge-conflict handling bugs: deferred markDone, respawn strategy, conflicted flag, worktree cleanup, failure recording

userStories.title: Set conflicted flag after rebase-then-merge failure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need mergeWave to always set conflicted:true when a branch fails to merge so that consumers can reliably detect the failure.
acceptanceCriteria: In mergeWave (src/merge.ts), when rebaseBranch succeeds but mergeBranch returns false, set mergingResult.conflicted = true
The stop strategy correctly triggers stoppedAt in this rebase-ok-merge-fail case
The respawn strategy skips the branch and continues in this case
New test: rebase succeeds, merge fails -- result has conflicted:true and merged:false
New test: rebase succeeds, merge fails with stop strategy -- stoppedAt is set
Existing merge tests still pass
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Lines 177-182 of src/merge.ts -- after successful rebase, mergeBranch result is assigned to merged but conflicted stays false. Also need to add strategy handling (stop/continue) in this branch.

userStories.title: Record failed tickets in progress.md
userStories.description: As a user, I want progress.md to show which tickets failed and their exit codes so I can see the full picture without checking log files.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a function or modify checkTicket in src/progress.ts to record failures with done:false and an exit code
renderProgress shows failed tickets with unchecked checkbox and exit code metadata
In runWavesIsolated (src/orchestrator.ts), call the failure-recording function when an agent exits non-zero
commitProgress is called after recording the failure
New test: checkTicket with done:false records exit code and keeps done as false
New test: renderProgress shows unchecked box with exit code for failed ticket
Existing progress tests still pass
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: checkTicket currently hardcodes done:true. Either add a new function (e.g. failTicket) or add a done parameter to checkTicket.

userStories.title: Defer markDone until after merge
userStories.description: As a user, I want tickets to stay ready-for-agent until their branch is successfully merged so that failed merges don't silently drop my work or unblock dependents prematurely.
acceptanceCriteria: In runWavesIsolated, markDone is not called until mergeWave confirms the branch merged successfully
checkTicket in progress.md is not called for a ticket whose merge failed
If an agent exits 0 but its merge conflicts, the ticket retains status ready-for-agent on disk
Dependents of an unmerged ticket are not unblocked in subsequent waves
New test: agent exits 0, merge conflicts -- ticket stays ready-for-agent
Existing tests for the happy path (agent succeeds, merge clean) still pass
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Currently markDone is called at line 533 of src/orchestrator.ts before the merge at line 562. Move markDone and checkTicket calls to after mergeWave, keyed on each branch's merge result.

userStories.title: Clean up worktrees after successful merge
userStories.description: As a user, I want worktrees for successfully merged tickets removed automatically so I don't accumulate sibling directories after a large run.
acceptanceCriteria: After a ticket's branch is successfully merged in runWavesIsolated, its worktree is removed via removeWorktree
Worktrees for failed or conflicted tickets are left intact for manual inspection
If worktree removal fails (e.g. directory already gone), the error is logged but does not stop the run
New test: after a successful wave, merged worktrees no longer exist on disk
New test: after a failed ticket, its worktree still exists
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: removeWorktree already exists in src/worktree.ts. Needs to be imported in orchestrator.ts and called after mergeWave for each successfully merged branch.

userStories.title: Implement respawn on merge conflict
userStories.description: As a user, I want the orchestrator to re-run the agent in the same worktree when a merge conflicts so the agent can resolve the conflict, matching the documented behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: When mergeWave reports a branch as conflicted and strategy is respawn, runWavesIsolated re-runs spawnAgent in that ticket's existing worktree
Before re-running, the worktree is updated to reflect the current base branch (merge or rebase from base so the agent sees the latest code)
If the re-spawned agent exits 0, merge is retried
If the re-spawned agent fails or retry merge still conflicts, ticket stays ready-for-agent and is reported
Respawn is attempted at most once per ticket per wave to avoid infinite loops
New test: two-branch wave where second branch conflicts, agent is re-spawned and succeeds on retry
New test: respawn agent fails -- ticket stays ready-for-agent
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 (correct conflicted flag) and US-003 (deferred markDone). The respawn loop runs after mergeWave, iterating conflicted results and re-spawning once each.
